# SPD-089 — Bash hook: a glob or an expansion that becomes one of SPD-049's file-writing git options is read only as spelled

## Brief
SPD-049 reads every literal spelling of an option that names a file git writes -- spaced, '=', a clustered short option, an abbreviated long option -- but a word that only becomes one of them after the shell expands it is not read at all, so 'git archive --outp?t=<path> HEAD' and 'git archive $OPT HEAD' pass the check SPD-049 added. Two things are needed and both live outside SPD-049's deliverable globs: expansions.git_read_index stops at a verb that is not in syntax.GIT_VERB_PROGRAM_OPTIONS, so the option word is never a read point, and globbing.GLOB_SAMPLES holds none of SPD-049's verbs or options, so a glob that could match one is not read as it. This is the same pair of changes SPD-051 needed for the program-naming options, on the new table.

Evidence: SPD-051's own note records it: 'GLOB_SAMPLES held none of these verbs or options, and git_read_index stopped at the verb, so the option was never a read point at all' (tests/test_hooks.py GitVerbProgramOptionTest.test_a_glob_that_expands_to_a_program_option_is_read). SPD-049 added syntax.GIT_VERB_FILE_OPTIONS, GIT_FILE_OPTIONS and GIT_VERB_FILE_POSITIONALS, read by git_verbs.git_write_targets, and neither globbing.py nor expansions.py (both outside SPD-049's globs) knows about them. Fix sketch: sample the new tables in globbing.GLOB_SAMPLES and extend expansions.git_read_index / verb_option_read_index to the verbs of GIT_VERB_FILE_OPTIONS, then pin it with the shape of test_a_glob_that_expands_to_a_program_option_is_read.
